steps.content: [Startled Awake]
When you wake up, dawn is barely breaking over the Bureau. Faint light filters through the window into your room, bringing with it the subtle chill of early morning.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's wrong, Hecate? You've got dark circles under your eyes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I'm glad you're alright. Adjutant Nightingale asked me to give this to you.

Hecate's tone remains calm as ever, but it's clear that she's been worried all night. You choose not to call her out on it, and don't bother to mention the new mass of Mania that's now inside you. Instead, you gently pat her head to reassure her and take the report from her hands.

Sure enough, while you were unconscious, the Bureau discovered the strange scent emanating from the picture book and began investigating Morveth Castle. However, the border satellite town has been abandoned for years and is in a remote location, so pinpointing its exact coordinates will take some time.
You'll find it—not just to resolve the Mania anomaly at the castle, but because you made her a promise... You open the book again, but your hand freezes mid-motion.
Did the story in the picture book... change the moment you opened it?

Thorns blanket black stones, a bride roams Morveth Castle—moonlight, ceremony, music begins. Mottled skin, a magic ring clutched tight, guests have departed, taking with them dreams and night. Yet no one sees what lies within, her dress sweeps the stone stairs, the bride has a secret that cannot be uncovered. You, who turn these pages—███, reaching for light and shadow, ignored the game of reality. The moon never sets, the ring remains—new abandonment, new solitude, new lonely shadow.

This is no hallucination... The symbols on the book twist before your eyes as the text gradually turns crimson, the red spreading and consuming every inch of white space. Then, without warning, flames leap from the page.

Fire consumes the page from its edges, following the paths of the text until the entire page is scorched black. At the center, the smudged text resists, untouched until the flames reach their final moment. As the flames finally recede, a single line of embers lingers, tracing the smudged words...
You, who turn these pages, ${PlayerName}.
It's your name.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName} os
steps.content: The coffin reminds me of the Romanesque Hall, the decor echoes the style of Sloane Street, and the ghost story brings to mind the Buonanotte Factory. An unfamiliar, enclosed space thick with Mania, an unstable Sinner with inexplicable fixation... It's practically tailor-made for me.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: When the moon reached its zenith, I made a wish to the night sky, hoping I too would be granted a destined lover.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Morveth Castle has the power to manifest longing into physical form—that's how No. 15 and Dullahan came into existence. But that power alone couldn't possibly target you so precisely, could it? Did you know our beautiful bride before all this?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't know Graves, but I can't rule out the possibility that someone who knows us both arranged this "match."
[Exit flashback]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hecate, I need Labyrinth to access all of her memories about finding this picture book. Also, check with everyone at the Bureau to see if anyone has smelled a similar fragrance.
You pass the scrap of paper to Hecate, your name etched onto its scorched surface.
Whoever's hiding in the shadows watching this must be feeling quite pleased with themselves right now.

They sent you into this perfectly arranged wedding exploiting Graves's obsession, knowing you'd be lured toward the shadow festering within her... And as you willingly bore the contamination for Graves, they kept on nurturing the darkness growing within her. What a cruel, twisted scheme.
The Mania you consumed in your dream churns restlessly within your body... You have a terrible feeling that the worst is yet to come.
[Castle]

When the final vow was uttered, the figure in the gray coat vanished, yet the sky above Morveth Castle remained without dawn. Graves still sits by the window where you parted, her fingertips gently brushing the sill, feeling the warmth you left behind.

In her palm lies the ring, its pupil gem alternately contracting and dilating. With the ring as its center, Mania silently seeps out—the very power you should have completely eliminated now regenerating in Graves's palm.
Red markings spread across her skin, winding like serpentine veins and consuming her natural pallor.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: So this is my fate after all... Of course. How could anyone ever accept a monster like me?
[Flash to partially corrupted state] [Add horror sound effect]
